insights.text: 10 invoice lines have no Vendor GSTIN on record (invoice value: ₹102.01 Cr). These will not appear in GSTR-2B auto-population and risk ITC denial during GST reconciliation. Obtain GSTINs from vendors immediately.

681 records (56.1%) are ITC Non-Eligible — representing ₹5.86 Cr of non-recoverable input tax that will flow to P&L as cost. This exceeds half the register volume; review procurement categories to confirm correct ITC treatment.

Top 3 vendors represent 29.6% (₹55.83 Cr) of total purchase value — vendor mix is reasonably diversified. Vendors: JINDAL STEEL & POWER LIMITED (₹35.25 Cr); JINDAL STEEL & POWER LIMITED II (₹15.46 Cr); RHI MAGNESITA GMBH (₹5.11 Cr).
Tax composition: IGST ₹5.86 Cr (59.2%), CGST ₹2.02 Cr (20.4%), SGST ₹2.02 Cr (20.4%). Tax type mix between inter-state (IGST) and intra-state (CGST/SGST) looks balanced.

Purchase mix: Goods 846 lines (₹86.21 Cr), Services 253 lines (₹2.44 Cr), Capital Goods 113 lines (₹5.58 Cr, tax ₹74.82 L). Capital goods ITC (₹74.82 L) must be availed in 60 equal monthly instalments — track separately in TRAN/ITC ledger.
Business Place 'IN06' has the highest purchase volume at ₹37.38 Cr (19.8% of total) across 7 active business places. Ensure GST state registrations and filing calendars are current for all locations.

Blended effective tax rate is 18.51% on a taxable base of ₹86.24 Cr (total tax: ₹15.96 Cr). ITC recovery rate is 43.8% — 531 of 1,213 records are ITC-eligible. Maximising eligible ITC is key to reducing net GST outflow.
